name: Definite Integrals Evaluation Trap
description: Frame the problem as deducing definite integrals between reference points. The additive property of integrals perfectly models path connectivity in a graph. However, because integrals are strongly associated with contiguous intervals on a 1D line, models are highly likely to assume a path graph structure or attempt 1D prefix-sum logic, failing to recognize and handle the general tree structure provided in the input.
